title: A Repeatable 15-Minute DIY Product Photo Workflow
description: Create a repeatable phone-photography and browser-based background-removal workflow without pretending it replaces every professional shoot.

blocks.text: The average freelance product photographer charges $30-100 per photo. For a 50-SKU catalog, that's $2,500-5,000. Most starting sellers can't afford this. Turns out, they don't have to.
Here's the 15-minute-per-product workflow that matches paid photographers.
Minute 1-2: Setup

items.text: Set up near a north-facing window (or any window with indirect light)
Lay a white sheet or foam board as your background

blocks.text: That's your entire studio. Cost: under $10.
Minute 3-8: Shoot
For each product:
Five shots. Move around the product instead of moving the product. Consistent shots come from consistent angles.
Take 2-3 versions of each in case you need alternates.
Minute 9-12: Background Removal
Upload all shots to edit-photo.com. Batch process. Remove backgrounds.
Apply consistent output:
Minute 13-14: Variations
From the transparent PNG, generate:
Three variations per product, ready for different platforms.
Minute 15: Export and Save
Export in the right sizes:
Save with SKU-based filenames. Organized. Ready to upload.
The Real Math
15 minutes × 50 products = 12.5 hours total. Two solid weekend afternoons.
Compare to:

items.text: Hiring a photographer: $2,500-5,000 and 2-3 weeks turnaround
Learning Photoshop: 40+ hours minimum before you're competent
Doing it wrong: months of poor conversion and lost sales

blocks.text: The Quality Gap Nobody Mentions

Freelance photographers often deliver stiff, generic catalog shots—especially at low price points. Your DIY workflow, done well, often produces better results because you know your product's key selling angles.
The gap between "AI-tool DIY" and "hired photographer" in 2026 is smaller than it's ever been. In many cases, DIY wins.
The Batch Advantage
Don't shoot one product at a time. Batch:

items.text: Edit all 20 through edit-photo.com in one sitting
Export and organize in one operation

blocks.text: You'll process 20 products in the same time it takes to properly set up for one.

Your Sunday afternoon can produce a month's worth of catalog photos. Start free at edit-photo.com.
